description: This file implements a minimal Supabase authentication client using the httpx library to perform signup and sign-in operations, avoiding heavy SDK dependencies.

classes.name: SupabaseAuthClient
classes.description: A minimal client for handling user signup and authentication with Supabase using HTTP requests, designed to be lightweight and dependency-free.

methods.name: __init__(self, supabase_url: str, supabase_key: str)
methods.description: Initializes the client with the Supabase URL and key, setting up default headers.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] sign_up(self, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Performs user signup via Supabase's auth endpoint, returning response JSON or raising exceptions on errors.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] sign_in(self, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Performs user sign-in via Supabase's token endpoint, returning response JSON or raising exceptions on errors.

ctags.name: sign_in
ctags.pattern: /^    async def sign_in(self, *, email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: sign_up
ctags.pattern: /^    async def sign_up(self, *, email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
